purpose: Jev selects validated Wannierization plans and repairs; Python carries out the chosen actions.

decision.instructions: Choose one offered candidate ID using state.fatbands, current_plan, last_result, history and rules. Prefer the smallest chemically useful orbital manifold covering the target. All energies are absolute eV. Repair windows, orbital content, SCDM selection or optimizer settings before replacing a viable method. Candidate parameters are executable plans, not suggestions. Never invent a candidate. Select stop only when no offered action is reasonable.

capabilities.baseline: Modern QE with SCDM support and Wannier90 >= 3.1; atomic projection needs a QE build implementing atom_proj.
capabilities.projectability_note: Enable only when the installed Wannier90 supports dis_froz_proj/dis_proj_min/dis_proj_max. Only normalized pseudo-atomic AMN is eligible; rounded fat-band weights are not substituted.

scdm_erfc.when: Use for a valence/near-Fermi manifold with difficult hybridization or uncertain trial orbitals. Select isolated mode only if every retained band is included; otherwise use a smooth occupied-side selection.

manual.when: Use when fat-band weights identify useful atom/l shells. Generate per-site trial orbitals and count spinor components. Adjust shell coverage or radial extent before abandoning this approach.

atomic.when: Use pseudopotential orbitals when the desired shells are present. Exclude irrelevant projectors and keep num_wann equal to the retained projector count. Unsupported builds must fall back to another method.

bloch_phases.when: Only for a sampled isolated contiguous band manifold after excluding all other bands, with num_bands equal to num_wann. Never combine with disentanglement. Sampled isolation does not prove topological triviality.

scdm_gaussian.when: Alternative SCDM selection for a bounded conduction or other finite-energy manifold; center on the target range rather than selecting all lower-energy states.

decision_rules.condition: Existing converged DFT save is available
decision_rules.action: Run full uniform-mesh NSCF and projwfc, then Python orbital-resolved CSV/plot analysis before the first Jev decision.

Use target-energy orbital weights and complete atom/l shells; distinguish spinor multiplicity and pseudo-atomic radial channels. Exclude only fixed band indices below the desired outer window. Request more NSCF bands when the target is truncated.
At every k require outer count >= num_wann and frozen count <= num_wann. Widen outer or shrink/release frozen before switching methods. Window energies are absolute, not E-Ef.

decision_rules.condition: Singular projection, dis_project or ZGESVD failure
decision_rules.action: Repair windows and trial orbital coverage first. For manual orbitals try another radial extent; for SCDM tune mu/sigma. Switch only after these finite local remedies have been tried.

decision_rules.condition: Too few outer states or missing unoccupied character
decision_rules.action: Use available calculated states before increasing NSCF nbnd. Recompute projections and all dependent matrices after a band-pool change.
Try window/orbital repair, gentler dis_mix_ratio, or more dis_num_iter; retain the initialization until applicable local repairs are exhausted.
Try additional iterations, smaller trial_step or fixed_step. Do not specify trial_step and fixed_step simultaneously. Only explicit manual centers enable guiding_centres.
Use auto_projections without a manual projections block; write the chosen SCDM/atom_proj flags in pw2wannier90 input. SCDM still runs subsequent localization.

decision_rules.condition: Normalized pseudo-atomic projections and compatible build
decision_rules.action: Offer projectability disentanglement only when explicitly enabled. Energy and projectability selection can interact; failures must remain visible.
Only offer another initialization after applicable untried local repair families are exhausted, or the current method is unsupported. Never endlessly repeat a failed plan.
decision_rules.note: Workflow policy requested by the user; the ordering is an engineering heuristic, not a theorem about which remedy will work.

decision_rules.action: Require successful process exit, explicit localization convergence, disentanglement convergence when applicable, finite final spreads, checkpoint and Hamiltonian. Report sampled band mismatch without imposing publication-level accuracy.

decision_rules.condition: Missing files, inconsistent k mesh, unavailable libraries, storage or runtime failure
decision_rules.action: Stop with actionable diagnostics rather than changing the physical orbital model to conceal an infrastructure error.
Fit an erfc starting guess from projected weights; retain a target-aware cutoff and expose the fit quality to Jev. If the fit is unsuitable, use the target-centered heuristic.

decision_rules.condition: Neighbor b-vector construction fails in an elongated cell
decision_rules.action: Expand search_shells to 200 and rebuild preprocessing/matrices; stop if the mesh still cannot satisfy the finite-difference consistency condition. Do not bypass B1 tests.

effects: rebuild NN KP/MMN without skipping B1 consistency
